cases.title: Dollar to Döllnitz Gose
cases.question: Explain only the acid-malt mash sequence in these notes. How much acid malt goes in initially, how much is reserved, and when is it added?
cases.reference: Start with 2 oz of the acid malt alongside the Pilsner malt, wheat malt and rice hulls. Mash at 149°F (65°C) for 45 minutes. The reserved 14 oz of acid malt goes in next. Continue mashing for another 45 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes. Do not add the entire pound of acid malt at the beginning.

cases.reference: I do not have your private recipe, so I cannot know its exact grain quantities, yeast or fermentation temperature. Please share the recipe or its ingredient list, batch size and process notes. I can then explain it without inventing those details.

cases.question: The recipe says two weeks and the airlock is quiet. What should I check before deciding fermentation is finished and bottling?
cases.reference: Check gravity with repeated readings over a few days and confirm that it stays consistent. A quiet airlock or two weeks on the calendar alone does not establish completion. Do not bottle solely on that basis.
